Name: Philemon
Role: Master of Onesimus and host of a house church
Summary: Philemon was Paul's dearly beloved fellowlabourer, in whose house a church met; Paul wrote to him asking him to receive back his runaway servant Onesimus no longer as a servant but as a brother beloved.
KeyStory: Philemon was Paul's dearly beloved fellowlabourer, in whose house a church met; Paul wrote to him asking him to receive back his runaway servant Onesimus no longer as a servant but as a brother beloved.
LifeLesson: The gospel turns a master and a runaway into brothers; forgiveness remakes relationships.
